settings.strip_title: Got a Build In Mind in West Footscray?
settings.strip_sub: Tell us your car and your goals, and we'll map out a package that suits.

settings.question: Do you build performance cars from West Footscray?
settings.answer: Yes. West Footscray is about a 8 minute drive from our Sunshine West workshop. Come in with the car and what you are chasing, and we will talk through what makes sense for your goals and your budget.

settings.question: What sort of performance upgrades do you do?
settings.answer: Bolt-on upgrades and tuning, along with the supporting mods that have to come with them: intake, exhaust, cooling and fuelling. We put them together as one package so the parts complement each other rather than fighting each other.

settings.question: Will the car still be reliable to drive every day?
settings.answer: That is the whole point of how we build. Power is easy; power that lasts is what matters, so we keep the car drivable and dependable. If you want a daily driver with a bit more in it, we build for that rather than handing you something you have to nurse.

settings.question: Do you tune, or only fit parts?
settings.answer: Both. Tuning is part of the package, not an afterthought, and the cooling and fuelling get matched to the upgrades at the same time. Fitting parts without tuning to suit them is how builds end up disappointing or fragile.

settings.question: Do you work on all makes and models?
settings.answer: Yes. We work on all makes and models, and if you drive a Holden or Commodore you are in specialist hands, since parts and performance are what we are known for.

settings.question: How much does a performance package cost?
settings.answer: It depends entirely on the car and what you want out of it, so we talk through your goals and your budget first and then map out a package that fits. Tell us the car and what you are chasing and we will give you a straight answer on what is realistic.

settings.question: What do you need from me to work out a build?
settings.answer: The car, how you actually use it, what you want out of it, and roughly what you want to spend. That is enough for us to put together a combination that suits, rather than guessing at a parts list.

settings.question: Where are you and when are you open?
settings.answer: The workshop is at 4/94 Boundary Road, Sunshine West VIC 3020, open Monday to Friday 8:00am to 5:00pm and Saturday 8:00am to 12:00pm. Give us a call on 0411 019 935 to talk through a build.

settings.foot_sub: We're happy to help. Give the workshop a call or send an enquiry and we'll get back to you.
